candidates.description: This feature vector represents the Thai consonant letter 'ส' (So Suea) appearing either independently or combined with various Thai vowel signs, tone marks, and preceding characters.
This vector activates strongly for the Thai consonant 'ก' (ko kai) and its various combinations with vowels and tone marks.
This feature vector represents the Thai consonant 'ม' (Mo Ma) combined with various vowels and tone marks.
This feature vector represents the Thai consonant letter 'ว' (wo waen) and its various combinations with vowel marks and tones.
This feature vector represents the concept of sovereign governance and the state apparatus.
This feature vector represents European nationalities, languages, and geopolitical entities across multiple scripts and languages.
This vector activates on common linguistic subwords and word fragments across diverse languages and writing systems.

This feature vector activates strongly on tokens related to the Nazi party and German national identity, likely capturing multilingual representations, sub-word components, and historical associations of Nazism.

This vector represents common suffixes and morphological endings used to form nouns, adjectives, and ideological terms across multiple languages.
